task_title: daemon pipeline executor import path resolution
task_criteria: getPipelineExecutorCandidates in src/daemon/daemon.ts resolves the pipeline executor for src/, specs/daemon.spec.dir/ and dist/ layouts; npx vitest run tests/daemon-executor-OBS-7.test.ts exits 0 with every test passing.

items.criterion: getPipelineExecutorCandidates in src/daemon/daemon.ts resolves the pipeline executor for src/, specs/daemon.spec.dir/ and dist/ layouts; npx vitest run tests/daemon-executor-OBS-7.test.ts exits 0 with every test passing.
items.detail: src/daemon/daemon.ts:32-40 defines getPipelineExecutorCandidates anchored to the module URL (default pathToFileURL(__filename)), choosing ts/js extension from the module pathname and returning ../pipeline/executor.<ext> plus ../../pipeline.spec.dir/src/executor.<ext>. All three layouts verified on disk: src/pipeline/executor.ts is a symlink to specs/pipeline.spec.dir/src/executor.ts (so both src/ and specs/daemon.spec.dir/ layouts resolve to it), and dist/src/daemon/daemon.js:28 carries the compiled equivalent resolving to dist/src/pipeline/executor.js. Test run: `npx vitest run tests/daemon-executor-OBS-7.test.ts` exit_code=0, output 'Test Files  1 passed (1)' / 'Tests  9 passed (9)', including per-layout runtime resolution tests, scratch-project stage execution through each layout, and a compiled-CLI watcher cascade test. [resolution 0.02; src/daemon/daemon.ts, tests/daemon-executor-OBS-7.test.ts]

items.criterion: Derived: executePipeline consumes getPipelineExecutorCandidates and fails loudly when no candidate resolves
items.detail: src/daemon/daemon.ts:395-412 iterates the candidates, skips missing files via existsSync(new URL(spec)), dynamic-imports the first existing one, and throws an error naming every candidate when none load; the path is reachable from the 'converged' handler at daemon.ts:113-118. The 9/9 passing tests in tests/daemon-executor-OBS-7.test.ts exercise this end-to-end (stage execution through all three layouts and the compiled CLI cascade asserting no 'Cannot find module|Pipeline execution error').
